useCase: High-fidelity replacement room props for Human Protocol escape-room config scenes. Existing hp_* model paths are overwritten where modelKey already existed; additional room furniture and terminals are available by modelKey.
webBudgetNote: These are intentionally uncompressed final-art GLBs for review and desktop/Steam-grade targets. Run the Human Protocol optimization pipeline before mobile/web production.

assets.notes: Original Human Protocol IP procedural GLB from webgpu-robot-lab final art pass. Contains embedded image2 textures where applicable; compress/Draco/KTX2 for web budget later.
